evd_title: Median quote similarity with original full text was 99 percent across LLM extracted quotes
finding: Median quote similarity with original full text was 99 percent across LLM extracted quotes
P: 112 SRs/MAs in pediatric surgery (Cullis et al.) for PRISMA/AMSTAR; 56 RCTs from PragMeta for PRECIS-2
I: Claude-3-Opus (PNG pages), Claude-2, GPT-4-32k-0613, GPT-3.5-turbo-16k-0613, Mixtral-8x22B; extract-quote-rate prompt, temp 0; asked to extract 1-3 quotes per item
O: Median quote similarity to full text 99% (PRISMA, AMSTAR, PRECIS-2); some quotes from prompt briefings (Claude, Mixtral)
T: Not reported on page; models queried Aug 2023-Apr 2024 per Woelfle cost EVD (paper 2024)
